paper.title: Discovering Quantum Phase Transitions with Fermionic Neural Networks
paper.authors: G. Cassella, H. Sutterud, S. Azadi, N. D. Drummond, D. Pfau, J. S. Spencer, W. M. C. Foulkes

results.system_description: 3D homogeneous electron gas, N = 27 (27 up, 0 down), r_s = 0.2, body-centred cubic cell, Gamma point
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of the neural-network wave function (FermiNet n_det=16 (complex for rs<=1)) at this N, r_s and cell, without finite-size correction or twist averaging.
results.notes: As printed (energy per electron, in Hartree). Madelung term: Coulomb energy per cell of infinite periodic lattice, Ewald (Fraser 1996), i.e. Madelung included. Verified: E_HF/N (surveyor-computed, Madelung incl.) + E_corr/N reproduces the FermiNet column of Pescia Table tab::unpolarized14 to 1e-6 Ha.. Boundary: periodic, Gamma point (Bloch condition with zero twist, supplementary Eq. supercell_bloch; no twist averaging).

issues: The N = 14 table prints the total correlation energy per cell relative to Hartree-Fock, which needs a Hartree-Fock energy the paper does not print; those values are not entries. The N = 27 energies here use a body-centred cubic cell and are a different instance from the simple cubic N = 27 cell of arXiv:2305.07240.
